trigger: User reported M9V, M9Y, M10B, M10E, M10P, M10P2 and M10W19 loops all stopped while collector/M7C/M8C and other processes remained running.
known_implementation_risk: All seven fresh-shadow loops are fail-closed and currently terminate the forever process after a single cycle exception. An abrupt termination can also leave a stale exclusive lock.
purpose: Collect the exact local process, lock, runtime, status/state, output timestamp, log-tail and GOLD CSV frontier evidence before any recovery or runtime behavior change.
required_evidence: Windows command lines for matching loop processes
runtime manifest existence and immutable prospective start
latest output summary status/build time/server frontier
current goldsharp M1/M5/M15/H1/H4/D1 last rows and file mtimes
after_review: Classify the common stop cause. Only then may a separate frozen reliability correction distinguish transient retryable conditions from hard integrity failures. Existing fail-closed integrity checks must not be weakened blindly.
